2608.31077.title: Reconciling Process Supervision with Outcome-Based Credit in Agentic Policy Optimization
2608.31077.paper_summary: Outcome-based reinforcement learning provides verified feedback for language-model agents, but assigns trajectory-level advantage uniformly to all decisions, yielding coarse credit over long-horizon interactions. On-policy self-distillation offers finer supervision by re-evaluating sampled behavior with privileged information (PI) available only during training. However, fine-grained supervision is not necessarily fine-grained credit: PI-induced likelihood changes describe how additional information alters policy preference, but do not directly determine how an executable action should inherit the verified task outcome. This creates a supervision-credit gap. Privileged signals may be irrelevant to the current interaction state, operate at a token granularity misaligned with executable decisions, and lack the outcome semantics required for reinforcement. We introduce TASPO, which converts privileged supervision into outcome-grounded action credit. TASPO constructs decision-applicable PI from verified successful experience, aggregates PI-induced likelihood shifts at the executable-action level, and converts relative action support into positive, bounded, mean-preserving weights on the original trajectory advantage. Thus, the verified outcome determines the update direction and average scale, while PI only redistributes credit across actions. Across three agentic benchmarks, TASPO improves over GRPO by 10.6\% and generalizes better to unseen tasks. Further analysis indicates that TASPO reduces supervision mismatch and that action-level assignment stabilizes the policy optimization process. These findings offer the community another interesting perspective.
2608.31077.paper_summary_zh: 基於結果的強化學習為語言模型代理提供了經過驗證的反饋，但對所有決策均勻分配了軌跡級的優勢，導致在長期互動中產生粗略的信貸。基於策略的自我蒸餾通過重新評估帶有僅在訓練期間可用的特權信息（PI）的採樣行為，提供了更精細的監督。然而，精細的監督不一定意味著精細的信貸：PI引起的可能性變化描述了額外信息如何改變策略偏好，但並不直接決定可執行行動應如何繼承經過驗證的任務結果。這造成了監督與信貸之間的差距。特權信號可能與當前互動狀態無關，以與可執行決策不一致的令牌粒度運作，並缺乏強化所需的結果語義。我們引入了TASPO，它將特權監督轉換為基於結果的行動信貸。TASPO從經過驗證的成功經驗中構建可決策的PI，在可執行行動層面聚合PI引起的可能性變化，並將相對行動支持轉換為對原始軌跡優勢的正向、有界、均值保持權重。因此，經過驗證的結果決定了更新方向和平均規模，而PI僅在行動之間重新分配信貸。在三個代理基準測試中，TASPO比GRPO提高了10.6\%，並且對未見任務的泛化能力更佳。進一步分析表明，TASPO減少了監督不匹配，並且行動級分配穩定了策略優化過程。這些發現為社群提供了另一個有趣的視角。
